text:
nina: Quick note  Horizon Systems asked for a tiny EAP run: 3-day lab slot to validate their NPU with our runtime + a short embargoed bench blurb. Can we scope?

marco: Who's the contact and is NDA in place?

nina: Contact is @tessa_h (Horizon). NDA not signed yet; legal_alex is on it. Tessa wants an on-site hardware bring and handwritten artifact transfer.

zhi: Ops: we can support a 3-node sandbox (npu-attached) in us-east-1 for 72 hours. Need IP allowlist and an encrypted transfer path.

legal_alex: I'll review the NDA today. Flag: model artifact transfers need encryption + a retention/destruction clause. Also check export controls if hardware leaves region.

marco: Bench ask? latency/throughput or kernel-level traces?

nina: Horizon wants p50/p95/p99 latency across chat and long-context 6k, plus a short quantization comparison. They want a one-paragraph embargoed summary. No raw kernel-level traces out.

zhi: We'll capture full telemetry internally but provide aggregated metrics for the public excerpt. Need their telemetry schema to map fields.

nina: Tessa said they'll send a scrubbed schema. Also requested SI (CloudBridge) in the room for deployment flow validation.

partner_ops_bot: Suggestion: use sandbox handle horizon-eap-1761. Need owners and run window.

marco: Owners: nina (partnership), zhi (ops), marco (runtime). Proposed window 2025-05-05 to 2025-05-08.

legal_alex: NDA draft uploaded. Added destruction clause (45 days) and embargo note (14 days). Please review comments.

zhi: Ops checklist: provision nodes, create S3 bucket with SSE-KMS, enable VPN allowlist, and generate ephemeral API keys. ETA Fri.

nina: Marketing want to hold on joint messaging until legal clears embargo. We'll prep a one-paragraph methodology blurb and a figure-ready chart template.

marco: Tech note: please identify expected batch mix. If mixed we run batch sweep [1,4,8] and a spike to 16. That'll influence kernel selection.

nina: Tessa (Horizon) replied: sending scrubbed telemetry and a representative load profile today.

partner_ops_bot: Run reservation created: horizon-eap-1761, owners: nina,zhi,marco, window set.

legal_alex: Reminder: redact kernel traces from any shared docs. We'll permit aggregated latency and throughput.

marco: I'll start a minimal bench harness template and drop in the repo.

nina: Thanks all  short sync Wed to confirm infra & NDA sign-off.

partner_ops_bot: Reminder: attach telemetry-handling checklist before run start.
